name: electron-wake-local
description: Local openWakeWord (小浪花) + Silero VAD TTS barge-in demo for Electron

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-wake-model.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.js && esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/renderer/bundle.js && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html && cp src/renderer/pcm-tap-processor.js dist/renderer/pcm-tap-processor.js
